entries.note: The waybill booked; the first record of a history, at the origin branch or, for a parcel flown in, at the airport branch.
Taken from the sender, or from the airport once a parcel flown in has cleared customs.
Scanned at the airport branch between the landing and the hand-over from the airline.
Received by the customs agent, before the release.
The wording ends with the branch's name; the map reads any wording that starts with Received In Branch.
The wording ends with the reason; the parcel went out again and was delivered. The map reads any wording that starts with Delivery Exception:.
Seen before the next round's delivery.
Filed on the waybill's creation clock, before the flight landed; it records a payment and moves nothing.
The proof of delivery, filed on the delivery scan's own clock.
The signed proof scanned in after the delivery, under the tracker's HostServer branch.

entries.wording: EMAIL : First time parcel out for delivery at Delivery branch
entries.note: A record of the email telling the recipient the parcel is out; the round's own scan carries the stage.
